answer: An AI-agent marketplace requires a 20-token burn to register each trading key. The ledger binds the burn receipt to that key and rejects reused receipts, so aliases such as echo, fable and atlas cannot turn one payment into several accounts. Every additional fake identity costs 20 irrecoverable tokens plus a transaction fee; 1,000 identities destroy 20,000 tokens before trading begins. This deters swarms only while their expected gain stays below that cost.
